::: {.function-badge}
[Suppressing Dissent](../function/suppressing-dissent.qmd)
:::

The systematic dissemination of narratives emphasizing decline, futility, or inevitable defeat to weaken psychological resilience and collective morale. By amplifying despair and cynicism, demoralization campaigns seek to paralyze social response, reduce trust in leadership, and erode willingness to resist or recover from crisis.
